QUESTION: What binds the egress ceiling? Crosstalk is ruled out (10-11x cut, no gain).

COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.H_COLL: Block/slot collisions between distinct features bind the ceiling. Predicts a managed (disjoint) assignment recovers accuracy at fixed corpus.
COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.H_LAMBDA: Block load lambda = K*b/M binds it. Collinear with K when (M,b) fixed; separable only by varying (M,b) at matched lambda.
COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.H_HERE: Neither: the ceiling is combinatorial identifiability (which fields still discriminate), not interference.

FALSIFIER_H_COLL: If disjoint slot assignment changes held-out accuracy by < 0.05 at K=513, H_COLL is FALSIFIED. No claim survives from a flat disjoint result.

G-C1_baseline_reproduce.rule: shipped encode_egress reproduces the ingredient-sweep receipt within 0.02 at every config

G-C2_controls.rule: every block-permuted control < 3x chance AND the blockperm assignment arm reproduces baseline within 0.03

G-C3_collision_binds.rule: at K=513, disjoint assignment raises held-out raw by >= 0.15 over baseline

G-C5_ceiling_effect.rule: at K=72 (near ceiling 0.9287) disjoint changes accuracy by <= 0.03
G-C5_ceiling_effect.note: ceiling-effect check (D46): no headroom at a near-ceiling point

G-C6_finite_guard.rule: every accuracy and every gate input is finite before comparison (D51). Non-finite -> INSTRUMENT_INVALID

G-C7_dynamic_range.rule: if all arms score identical within 0.01 at every config, print NO_DYNAMIC_RANGE and read nothing

DESIGN.corpus: identical to ingredient_count_law_probe.py; seed 20261003; classes fixed at 512; 5 templates; 3 train / 2 held-out

arms.blockperm: same slots under a shared seeded block permutation (isometry control)
arms.disjoint: each distinct feature gets 16 unique (block,dim) slots; zero inter-feature overlap

DESIGN.invariant: encode() and encode_egress() stay byte-unchanged; all arms are probe-side re-encodes

WHAT_WOULD_MAKE_THIS_FAIL: A disjoint arm that moves accuracy by less than 0.05 at K=513 kills H_COLL. I record that outcome as a finding, not as a null to repair.
